title: Quantized geometry and typed absence (DRAFT)
description: A measured ink box, or a typed reason there is none. Deliberately not a nullable rectangle: null would collapse 'could not measure', 'nothing to measure', and 'not asked to measure' into one value, and only the first is a declarable capability limitation.

qrect.title: QRect
qrect.description: A rectangle in integer centipoints as [x0, y0, x1, y1] — left, top, right, bottom. NOT [x, y, width, height]: the grounding wire format is edge-based, and a silent reinterpretation between the two conventions would place every citation highlight in the wrong spot while remaining structurally valid. Construction requires x1 > x0 and y1 > y0.

geometry_absence.title: GeometryAbsence
geometry_absence.description: Why a measurement is absent. Never a sentinel value: no zero box, no null island, no page-sized stand-in, and never height = font_size — a font-size-derived box is closer to invented than measured, and inventing a coordinate is forbidden.

oneOf.description: The reader has no usable metrics for this glyph's font. The only variant that counts toward a declared capability limitation, and the only one that causes omission from a grounding artifact.
The node kind has no geometry by definition, so absence is correct rather than a gap.
This profile does not declare the capability that would produce the measurement.
